cve_summary: GDAL through 3.0.1 has a poolDestroy double free in OGRExpatRealloc in ogr/ogr_expat.cpp when the 10MB threshold is exceeded.
commit_message: OGRExpatRealloc(): fix double-free when size to allocate is above the default 10MB threshold. Fixes https://bugs.chromium.org/p/oss-fuzz/issues/detail?id=16178. Credit to OSS Fuzz
extraction_reason: vulnerable-side scope spans 5 top-level constructs (functions/declarations), not a single function
